environment.description: Same Django application deployed on ECS Fargate with Aurora PostgreSQL. The DATABASES connection uses role 'svc_profile_ro' which was provisioned via Terraform module 'aurora-restricted-role' with pg_hba.conf entry restricting this role. The role has explicit grants: GRANT SELECT ON users_profile, users_activity TO svc_profile_ro; No other grants exist. The role also has ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES configured so future tables also only get SELECT. Connection is via IAM database authentication with the task role's policy scoped to rds-db:connect for this specific DB user. Note: the application code still constructs UPDATE and DELETE statements but these will receive PostgreSQL error 42501 (insufficient_privilege) at execution time, which is caught by the generic except block.

config.database_grants: GRANT SELECT ON users_profile, users_activity TO svc_profile_ro
config.default_privileges: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO svc_profile_ro
